date_arithmetic_recheck.method: Re-derived from the passage alone, with no reference to repair_log or self_blind_solve, then cross-checked against every other figure in the text.
date_arithmetic_recheck.result: Magasinet = 1889. 'Folkskolan i Sölvinge, uppförd 1904' is the nearest and only dated referent for 'I magasinet vid bryggan, murat femton år tidigare'; 1904 - 15 = 1889.
ledger: Bruket i drift 1868-1913 (45 år). Magasinet 1889 sits inside it.

Ringugn ersatte fältugnen 1884. 1889 > 1884 by five years, so the magasin wall is ring-kiln brick and paragraph 5's chamber mechanism ('Var i kammaren en sten hade stått syntes på den efteråt') applies to the very wall paragraph 1 exhibits. This is the defect the round-3 repair was chartered to fix and it is fixed.

Kollergången 1884. The magasin (1889) is post-kollergång, yet shows spalled flakes. No contradiction: the kollergång crushed 'de flesta' lime grains, not all, and the passage's own 1890s complaint record is post-1884 evidence that spalling continued.

Stämpeln försvann 1897; 'teglet under brukets första trettio år bar en stämpel'. 1868 through 1897 inclusive is exactly thirty operating years. Magasinet 1889 is operating year 22, therefore stamped, therefore attributable - which is what licenses paragraph 1's claim that the bruk is 'ovanligt lättläst'.

Folkskolan 1904 is operating year 37 and therefore unstamped. Not a defect: the passage never claims the stamp is the only attribution route, and a byggnadshistoriker's attribution of the last large building needs no stamp.
Enkelsortsbränning upphörde 1875. Both exhibited walls (1889, 1904) are post-1875 by 14 and 29 years, so neither can be traced to a single lergrav.
Vrenmark ledde 1879-1902; vattningen is his measure. Magasinet 1889 and the 1890s complaints both fall inside his tenure.
Strejken juli 1893 falls inside the April-October arbetsår.
Brandförsäkringen 1896 lists 'ugnen' in the singular - correct, since the fältugn was torn down in 1884 and only the ringugn remained.
Uppteckningen 1918 postdates the 1913 closure, as an oral-tradition record should.
Leran grävdes på hösten, låg ute till våren, var lös 'i april'; arbetsåret began 'i slutet av april'. The two clocks agree.
date_arithmetic_recheck.conclusion: Every figure in the passage reconciles. No arithmetic defect remains.

findings.claim: Carried minor: q:1 option B is tagged reversed_causality where the causal arrow is intact and only the stage of the process moves.
findings.evidence: q:1/B: 'Kalkkornen sprängde sönder stenens yta i ugnens hetta under själva bränningen.' Tag sites: planted_traps.1.B 'reversed_causality (skadans tidsled inverterat)' and the q:1 rationale 'B är reversed_causality i tidsledet'. las/families.md defines the tag as 'Right elements, wrong direction - cause/effect or subject/object swapped'. In B the lime grain is still the agent and the spalled face still the patient; what moves is the stage (firing heat instead of later moisture uptake).
findings.why: The observation is correct and I confirm it on the merits, but ordering a relabel would make the record worse, not better. The taxonomy in las/families.md is closed at eight tags and contains no stage-shift or temporal-shift tag. The two nearest substitutes are both already spent inside the same four-option row - scope_shift on q:1/A and plausible_worldknowledge on q:1/D - so a substitution would either double-tag the row and blur it, or coin an off-taxonomy tag. The tag as actually written is not bare: both sites carry an explicit in-place qualifier ('i tidsledet', 'skadans tidsled inverterat') naming exactly what moved. And the only part of the record with teaching value, the rationale's substantive prose, describes the stage shift correctly and cites the refuting sentence verbatim: 'den flyttar sprängningen till själva bränningen, medan texten uttryckligen säger att detta sällan hände i ugnen'. Student-facing exposure is nil today: raw English taxonomy tokens appear in the rationale field of every candidate in batch16 and in earlier batches (checked batch12), so the field is internal QA prose by corpus-wide convention, and PRD 5.15 Layer 4 is deferred with no renderer. Net: real but cosmetic, with every available fix costing more accuracy than it buys. Logged for corpus hygiene if a stage-shift tag is ever added to families.md.

findings.claim: Carried minor: q:4 option D is tagged overgeneralisation where the integrated reviewer proposes true_but_irrelevant.
findings.evidence: q:4/D: 'Skärmtaken tycks ha blivit överflödiga sedan rökgaserna kunde torka godset.' families.md: true_but_irrelevant = 'True in itself but doesn't answer the stem'; overgeneralisation = 'Text says something nuanced/hedged; distractor makes it absolute'. The passage refutes D twice: paragraph 3 makes roofed drying capacity the binding constraint on summer deliveries ('Vad bruket kunde leverera under en sommar avgjordes därför av hur mycket gods som fick plats under taken'), and the 1896 brandförsäkring still insures 'skärmtaken'.
findings.why: I rule against the reviewer. true_but_irrelevant is defined by its first word: the proposition must be true in itself. D as a whole proposition is false and the text refutes it, so the proposed tag cannot apply, and applying it would additionally encode into the corpus the claim that D is true - the worse of the two errors. The incumbent tag fits the substance: D takes a bounded true premise from paragraph 4 (flue gases dried the goods standing next in line inside the ring) and pushes it out to the whole drying operation. families.md's own family notes gloss overgeneralisation as 'a sound inference pushed too far', which is exactly D's shape. The one imperfection is surface: D carries a hedge ('tycks ha') rather than an absolutiser, so it misses the gloss's lexical marker - but those markers are how absolutising usually surfaces, not the definition, and the hedge is doing separate deliberate work, since hedge_map requires a cautiously worded WRONG option in the row and q:4/D is it. half_right_conjunction would map onto D's true-premise/false-conclusion split, but it is already spent on q:4/C in the same row. Incumbent stands.
